name: era-pinned-peer-omits-protocol-version
description: a client talking down to a peer that predates the version field does not send it
kill: remove the gate on the protocolVersion declaration, so an old peer receives an input member it may reject

dotnet.intentional: The .NET client has no peer-ceiling option: it declares the version it speaks on every request, so there is nothing for this lane to gate. `requestAbsentPaths` is emptied only to displace the base expectation — an override replaces a key rather than removing it — and `request` is what pins the declaration that goes out instead.
